blocks.text: SHENZHEN, China — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. called for stronger cooperation in sustainable fisheries, healthcare, and in preparing economies for changing demographics, during the 33rd Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (Apec) Economic Leaders’ Meeting (AELM) here on Thursday. In his intervention, Marcos reaffirmed the government’s commitment to expanding trade, opening more opportunities for Filipino workers and professionals, and helping small businesses benefit from artificial intelligence and digital technology.
